positions.title: AIX Kernel Developer
positions.description:
- Lead engineer on Dynamic System Optimizer, a tool that automatically monitors and adjusts a partition's workload, boosting performance at the flick of a switch.
- Fixed dozens of kernel defects discovered by in house test teams and customer reports.

positions.title: Tutor, Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Tutored physics, chemistry, engineering, and computer science classes to multiple groups of students.
- Researched various ways to improve Android scheduler to favor UI satisfaction on demand.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
- Redesigned several web-page generating VB scripts into Java to make them more portable and easier to maintain
- Developed a prototype web application using JavaScript

positions.title: Co-op Engineer
positions.description:
- Monitored and maintained hundreds of hard drives in long-term regression testing.
- Developed an application in Java that monitored hard drives undergoing regression testing and remotely reported status to a client application.
